scope: Deduplicate identical immutable engineering-plan blob reads within one historical verification scan, without caching validation or authority.
riskAnalysis: Verification policy remains STRICT. Repeated metadata retrieval is removed, but every commit retains fresh tree enumeration, source classification, digest calculation and ordinary/proactive plan validation.

threatModel.assets: Source-bound historical plans, independent verification requirements and accurate CI outcomes.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Validated immutable Git blob identities to invocation-local parsed JSON; cloned records to unchanged validators.
threatModel.abuseCases: Path-keyed stale data, cross-run reuse, caller mutation poisoning, malformed trees, duplicate-plan suppression or cached acceptance.
threatModel.mitigations: Fresh ls-tree per commit, exact regular100644 blob/OID/path checks, cat-file by immutable OID, new Map per scan, isolated clones and no cached check results.

rollback: Revert only this loading optimization; the separately reviewed exact documentation recovery remains. Reversion restores repeated reads without changing any historical plan or execution permission.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Malformed JSON, unsafe modes/types and malformed object identities fail before usable plan output.
negativePaths.stale-state: Changed blob identity forces a new read; a separate invocation always rereads its plans.
negativePaths.concurrency: No shared or persistent cache exists; returned nested objects are isolated from later commit checks.
negativePaths.cancellation: Interrupted read-only scanning emits no passed verification receipt or execution grant.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: No agent worker is created; process exit discards the entire cache.
negativePaths.api-outage: No external API. Missing Git objects or read failures still block verification.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Every commit retains its actual source/risk/digest and unchanged mandatory checks; cache cannot grant permissions.
negativePaths.spending-limit: No model, browser, budget, billing, customer mutation or recurring work is introduced.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Duplicate matching records remain duplicates; unrelated missing plans and failed proactive checks remain failures.

proactiveReview.architecture: Small invocation-local immutable-data reader in existing preflight; no replacement workflow or evidence store.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Actual committed Git trees and blob objects; existing source-bound ordinary/proactive validators.
proactiveReview.threats: Cached verdicts or mutable shared plans could bypass review; neither is cached or shared.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Invalid metadata or JSON denies verification; no fallback to stale cached path data.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Independent tests cover same/changed blob, cross-invocation freshness, deep mutation isolation, unsafe entries and unchanged duplicate/missing-plan rejection.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Independent QA6/6 passed and Work Auditor approved actual implementation conditional STRICT.
proactiveReview.recovery: Preserve original full-history baseline result and timing limitations; rollback changes performance only, never historical evidence.
proactiveReview.readiness: Original110-commit scan passed and was observed running over five minutes. Time the final full-history validation; do not invent exact prior duration, Work-credit savings or provider-cost savings.
